items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: Yeah, well, I got a three-piece lined up of my own.

ctx.x: I used to hear you out on Magazine Street one time with a trio too, a guitar.

Yeah, well, I got a three-piece lined up of my own. I had, I called it the three Ls. It was, I was playing piano then, Albert Giles playing drums, and I had Al, Al, playing ghetto. I guess that's the one I heard.
You worked with Johnny St. Sarah then later too, didn't you, for a while?
